followUps.undecided: Three follow-ups on the same development. None is a first: a restatement of Conjecture 1 by the third party exists since 2026-09-05, and the search for an earlier formal proof of continuity was partial. The heavy ingredients of the continuity proof are Anthropic’s (uniqueness of the infinite cluster, the zero–one law, θ(p_c) = 0); the proofs of Conjectures 3 and 1 are Anthropic’s and Ahmed Bou-Rabee’s. “CERTIFIED, as printed” says the Lean sentence and our reading of the printed sentence are the same statement, by proof; it does not say the paper’s authors endorse either. On Conjecture 1 the independence is by procedure only.
